the number of researches about mathematics teaching has been increased in last five year.
the studies about mathematics teaching have increased in the last five years, and the number of studies done in geometry and examining mathematics-geometry together is very few.

the studies conducted about mathematics education in USOS and published within the last five years.
the descriptive content analysis of the studies towards mathematics teaching in USOS.
the descriptive analysis of the papers presented in International Classroom Teaching Symposium (USOS), which was held in Turkey in last five years and published in proceeding books.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the researches about mathematics teaching in elementary education have not been conducted with sufficient scientific and methodological quality.
the studies conducted in the field of mathematics teaching in primary schools are not sufficient and the researches conducted are not enough to provide a holistic viewpoint.

the studies about mathematics education are mostly conducted with elementary school students and pre-service elementary teachers, the researches are mostly survey and case studies, the researches mostly use test, interview, scale, open-ended question and questionnaire, the researches generally use content analysis and predictive statistics as data analysis technique.

it is necessary to increase the number of studies about mathematics teaching in primary education.
